props.mistake: Applying silicone sealant directly over old acrylic sealant, assuming the new sealant will adhere to the existing product.
props.correction: Silicone and acrylic are chemically incompatible; silicone will not bond to acrylic. All old sealant must be removed to base material.

props.mistake: Calculating joint width based only on temperature change, forgetting the 2x multiplication rule specified by ASTM C920.
props.correction: Joint width must equal at least 2 × the expected movement. A joint accommodating 5 inches of movement must be at least 10 inches wide.
